gymnasiumSpaces.title: Gymnasium space compatibility
gymnasiumSpaces.description: Public Gymnasium space conversions exposed by rlmesh.spaces.

rows.name: Box
rows.notes: Shape, dtype, low, and high bounds are preserved.

rows.name: Discrete
rows.notes: Count and start offset are preserved.

rows.name: Dict
rows.notes: Nested supported spaces are preserved by key.

rows.name: MultiDiscrete
rows.notes: Per-dimension counts and optional starts are preserved.

rows.name: Text
rows.notes: Length bounds are preserved; Gymnasium charset constraints are normalized to RLMesh text.

rows.name: Tuple
rows.notes: Nested supported spaces are preserved by position.

rows.name: Sequence
rows.notes: No public Python wrapper is exposed yet.

rows.name: Graph
rows.notes: No public Python wrapper is exposed yet.

rows.name: OneOf
rows.notes: No public Python wrapper is exposed yet.

rlmesh.Param.description: One declared construction parameter (validated, presentable, sweepable).

rlmesh.RLMeshException.description: Base class for every exception RLMesh raises.

rlmesh.predict_seed.description: Per-predict sampling seed mixed from an episode's reset seed and its re-plan ordinal.

rlmesh.current_workflow_edition.description: The bare YYYY.MM workflow edition this build runs at, on every build of it: the value to paste into a workflow_edition declaration. It names the contract and selects whichever spelling both sides offer, a prerelease or source build's cohort included.

rlmesh.build_info.description: This build's identity: package version, protocol generation, the workflow edition it advertises with its sealed base, and the cohort and git state behind that spelling.

rlmesh.BuildInfo.description: Immutable build identity returned by build_info(): version, protocol_generation, workflow_edition, workflow_edition_base, build_cohort, build_source, and git.

rlmesh.trial_index.description: Read the reserved trial_index reset option an env declared, from a reset's options mapping.

rlmesh.ENV_RESET_OPTIONS_KEY.description: Metadata key under which an env declares the reserved reset-option keys it wants delivered (rlmesh.env.v1.reset_options).

rlmesh.DESCRIBE_METADATA_KEY.description: Metadata/OCI-label key under which the versioned describe envelope is stored (rlmesh.describe.v1).

rlmesh.DESCRIBE_SCHEMA_VERSION.description: Schema version stamped into the envelope emitted by describe/describe_json.

rlmesh.__build__.description: Deprecated alias for build_info().workflow_edition; removed in 0.2. Reading it emits a DeprecationWarning.

rlmesh.adapters.ACTION_DELTA_POS.description: Action role for an end-effector Cartesian position delta (action/delta_eef_pos).

rlmesh.adapters.ACTION_DELTA_ROT.description: Action role for an end-effector rotation delta (action/delta_eef_rot).

rlmesh.adapters.ACTION_EEF_POS.description: Action role for an absolute end-effector position target (action/eef_pos).

rlmesh.adapters.ACTION_EEF_ROT.description: Action role for an absolute end-effector rotation target (action/eef_rot).

rlmesh.adapters.ACTION_GRIPPER.description: Action role for a gripper command (action/gripper).

rlmesh.adapters.ACTION_JOINT_POS.description: Action role for joint position targets (action/joint_pos).

rlmesh.adapters.ACTION_JOINT_VEL.description: Action role for joint velocity targets (action/joint_vel).

rlmesh.adapters.EEF_POS.description: Observation role for the end-effector Cartesian position (proprio/eef_pos).

rlmesh.adapters.EEF_ROT.description: Observation role for the end-effector rotation (proprio/eef_rot).

rlmesh.adapters.ENV_BRANCH_METADATA_KEY.description: Contract metadata key under which a branched environment publishes the discriminant binding its make() selected (rlmesh.adapters.v1.env_branch).

rlmesh.adapters.ENV_METADATA_KEY.description: Contract metadata key under which an environment publishes its EnvTags (rlmesh.adapters.v1.env_tags).

rlmesh.adapters.GRIPPER_POS.description: Observation role for the gripper opening state (proprio/gripper).

rlmesh.adapters.IMAGE_PRIMARY.description: Observation role for the primary scene camera (image/primary).

rlmesh.adapters.IMAGE_SECONDARY.description: Observation role for a secondary scene camera (image/secondary).

rlmesh.adapters.IMAGE_WRIST.description: Observation role for a wrist-mounted camera (image/wrist).

rlmesh.adapters.INSTRUCTION.description: Observation role for the task instruction text (text/instruction).

rlmesh.adapters.EEF_WRENCH.description: Observation role for the end-effector wrench [fx, fy, fz, tx, ty, tz] a wrist force/torque sensor reads (proprio/eef_wrench), framed.

rlmesh.adapters.BASE_ANG_VEL.description: Observation role for the base angular velocity, the IMU gyro (proprio/base_ang_vel).

rlmesh.adapters.BASE_ROT.description: Observation role for the base orientation (proprio/base_rot); read it with encoding="gravity_xyz" for projected gravity.

rlmesh.adapters.COMMAND_BASE_VEL.description: Command role for the base velocity setpoint [vx, vy, wz] the runner hands the policy (command/base_vel).

rlmesh.adapters.Provenance.description: Literal of where a state leaf's numbers come from: sensed, estimated, or privileged.

rlmesh.adapters.LEFT_ARM.description: Body part for the left arm (left_arm), where a role repeats across a bimanual body.

rlmesh.adapters.RIGHT_ARM.description: Body part for the right arm (right_arm).

rlmesh.adapters.ARM_2.description: Body part for the second arm when no side is meant (arm_2); the part the legacy _2 roles spell.

rlmesh.adapters.HEAD.description: Body part for the head (head), e.g. a head-mounted camera.

rlmesh.adapters.BASE.description: Body part for the mobile base (base).

rlmesh.adapters.LEFT_LEG.description: Body part for the left leg (left_leg).

rlmesh.adapters.RIGHT_LEG.description: Body part for the right leg (right_leg).

rlmesh.adapters.PARTS.description: The registered body parts, in registry order.

rlmesh.adapters.MODEL_METADATA_KEY.description: Contract metadata key under which a model publishes its ModelSpec (rlmesh.adapters.v1.model_spec).

rlmesh.adapters.ROTATION_DIMS.description: Mapping from each rotation encoding to its dimension count.

rlmesh.adapters.ConcatPart.description: One part of a Concat state input: a State leaf, a Constant block, or a bare role string.

rlmesh.adapters.Constant.description: A constant Concat part: dim copies of fill, read from nothing.

rlmesh.adapters.Previous.description: A state part reading the model's own previous action for a role: the raw output executed at the previous step, fill before the first.

rlmesh.adapters.FitMode.description: How an image is fit to a declared size: 'stretch', 'letterbox', or 'crop'.

rlmesh.adapters.Frame.description: Coordinate frame an absolute pose is expressed in: 'world' or 'robot_base'.

rlmesh.adapters.Reference.description: Pose a delta command is integrated against: 'current' (measured) or 'target' (last commanded).

rlmesh.adapters.Resample.description: Image resampling filter vocabulary for declared resizes.

rlmesh.adapters.InputNode.description: A node of the ModelSpec input tree: a leaf, a mapping, or a tuple of nodes.

rlmesh.adapters.ModelLeaf.description: A model-input leaf: Image, State, Concat, Text, or Custom.

rlmesh.adapters.ObsLeaf.description: An observation tag leaf: ImageTag, StateTag, TextTag, or Split.

rlmesh.adapters.ObsNode.description: A node of the observation tag tree: a leaf, a mapping, or a tuple of nodes.

rlmesh.adapters.ObsTransform.description: An in-process callable mapping a raw observation to one payload slot (Custom transform).

rlmesh.adapters.Rotation.description: A literal rotation authored as a state part's post_rotate.

rlmesh.adapters.RotationEncoding.description: Rotation encoding vocabulary (quat_xyzw, quat_wxyz, axis_angle, rot6d, rot6d_rowmajor, euler_xyz).

rlmesh.adapters.RotationTransform.description: An in-process callable repacking a rotation block for a CustomEncoding.

rlmesh.adapters.StackPad.description: Frame-window padding vocabulary: replicate the first frame, or pad black.

rlmesh.adapters.StackSpec.description: A declared frame window: non-positive frame offsets from the current step.
